result.summary: Found 2 issues: an unresolved localization key used as a section header and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: Second section header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper localized string and ensure translation files contain this key for all supported locales

issues.description: Favorite heart button on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no circular background while the card below it does, creating inconsistent styling
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark translucent circular background to all favorite icons for visual consistency and contrast
